claim: Source and documentation review of opendatalab/MinerU at commit 9227669985a7876abe5d3181b1cda11a844e7322, read from README.md at that commit. Repository description: "Transforms complex documents like PDFs and Office docs into LLM-ready markdown/JSON for your Agentic workflows.".

documentation_excerpts.text: MinerU 4.0 brings document parsing, a local document library, and service tools into one workflow for document conversion, application integration, and agent reading.

PDF and images support all four tiers. Office, OpenDocument, EPUB, OFD, HTML/MHTML, and CSV/TSV use local Flash native parsing. Plain text is read directly rather than parsed. Documents are not automatically uploaded to the official service; remote parsing requires explicit configuration.

limitations: Source and documentation review at the pinned commit only: not installed, executed, benchmarked or compared with any other component.
